t: This Essentials metal-clad switched USB socket provides reliable power and convenient charging for various devices. Featuring a 13A 2-gang 2-pole switched socket, it is ideal for workshops, garages, and utility rooms where robust power access is essential. The unit includes both Type A and C USB ports, delivering 3.1A and 15.5W for efficient charging of digital devices. Its durable powder-coated finish ensures longevity, while the secure screwed faceplate offers enhanced safety. Installation is straightforward with backed-out captive terminal screws and multiple knockouts.
